item.text: The CLI now supports the declared `. + 1` acceptance case, preserves one output line per generated value, and keeps compile/runtime failures mapped to the required exit codes. I also added explicit tests for arithmetic, multiple inputs, and generator output. Next I’m running those tests plus the full staged conformance runner to identify any boundary regressions.
